easy.def: Fine, not bad and not great.

more.def: Acceptable or satisfactory, or safe and not hurt.
examples: The test was okay, but I know I can do better.
Are you okay after your fall?
It is okay to ask for help when you are stuck.

easy.def: A word you say to mean yes.

more.def: A word used to agree with someone, or to show you understand.
examples: Okay, I will clean my room right after dinner.
Okay, let us all line up by the door.
